content:
deploybot: Rollback initiated for deployment redwood-runtime@v2.8.0 -> prod-eu3 due to elevated p95 latency and failed healthchecks :warning:
marta: seeing the same in prometheus — p95 jumped from 120ms to ~950ms right after canary ramp :grimacing:
ryan: can we cut traffic back to previous stable (v2.7.3) and pin until root cause known? :thinking_face:
lee: yes, initiating pin-and-rollforward. @deploybot please deploy rollback-tag: redwood-runtime@v2.7.3 and pin to prod-eu3, keep canary disabled for now.
deploybot: Acknowledged. Starting rollback sequence: pulling tag redwood-runtime@v2.7.3 (commit 8a4f3b1) -> draining new pods -> deploying stable -> running healthchecks. Steps logged to /var/log/deploy/1891234567.log
marta: quick note — KV cache TTLs got longer during the spike; might be a memory regression in the runtime kernel selection path. Capturing heap profiles now.
ryan: if cache warming will take >5m, route traffic to eu2 as fallback? We want minimal user impact.
lee: prefer pin-first then decide on cross-region failover. Pin should be fast. Also tagging ops for postmortem.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-045 — "prod-eu3 latency spike / rollback". Paging oncall roster.
marta: healthchecks returned OK on rollback candidate, but there was one transient 502 on shard-12 during drain. Nothing persistent.
deploybot: Rollback deploy completed and pinned to redwood-runtime@v2.7.3 on prod-eu3 :white_check_mark:. Deployed by lee. Commit 8a4f3b1. Duration: 3m 12s.
ryan: great — can we mark the canary as disabled and block auto-upgrades until postmortem?
lee: done. I set the rollout_policy to manual for prod-eu3 and added a hold reason: "post-rollback investigation".
marta: uploading heap/diff traces to the incident doc. Will start bisecting the v2.8.0 changes (focus: kernel selection + LRU caching tweaks).
oncall-bot: Incident updated: severity -> sev2. Assigned to marta, ryan.
ryan: follow-up actions: 1) smoke test suite run against v2.7.3 pin, 2) bisect v2.8.0, 3) coordinate canary retry behind feature-flag. I'll own #1 and #3.
marta: acknowledged. For the bisect, I'll try reproducer that ramps KV operations and measure p95.
lee: please also add a revert branch in the repo with the exact deploy manifest used by v2.7.3 so we can redeploy quickly if needed. Example command:
```
git checkout -b hotfix/revert-to-2.7.3 8a4f3b1
kubectl apply -f k8s/prod/eu3/deploy-2.7.3.yaml
```
ryan: noted. I'll run the smoke and post results in the incident. If smoke is green for 30m we'll close the incident and schedule a controlled attempt for a trimmed v2.8.0 later.
marta: thanks all. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre for visibility. :white_check_mark:
lee: closing thread here — keep updates in INC-2026-045 and #eng-releases if anything else pops.
